_about: Kokoro/misaki pronunciation overrides for narration names. Keys are words exactly as written in script.json; ps uses misaki US phonemes (A=eɪ I=aɪ O=oʊ W=aʊ Y=ɔɪ). Applied by scripts/plays/kokoro-narrate.py as lexicon golds, so captions and timing.json keep the real spelling. source: wiki-ipa (Wikipedia lead IPA, anglicised), knowledge, uncertain. default = what Kokoro said before (for review).

Abakshyn.who: Danyil Abakshyn — uk wiki stress Аба́кшин (a-BAK-shin)

Ayso.who: AYSO (as the lesson voicer lower-cases it)

Blanc.who: Laurent Blanc — French [blɑ̃], anglicised BLAHN (blˈɑŋ was heard as "Blong")

Borges.who: Humberlito Borges (Santos) — pt wiki (no IPA); Brazilian Portuguese: ge=zhe, final -es=ees (BOR-zhees)

Catela.who: Juanjo Catela — Spanish: ends in a vowel, so penultimate stress (ka-TEH-la)

Danyil.who: Danyil Abakshyn — passport name Даниїл (uk wiki); Ukrainian Даниї́л is stressed on the last syllable (da-ny-EEL)

Fareniuk.who: Artem Fareniuk — Фаренюк (uk wiki, no stress mark); Ukrainian -юк surnames stress the suffix, cf. Микитю́к (fa-re-NYUK)

Feixas.who: Miquel Feixas — Catalan: eix = aysh, unstressed a = ə, penultimate stress (FAY-shəs)

Fukin.who: Aleksandr Fukin — Фукин (ru wiki, no stress mark); Russian -ин surname keeps its one-syllable root stressed, cf. Пу́шкин (FOO-kin)

Geovany.who: Geovany Quenda — pt wiki (no IPA); Portuguese form of Giovanni: ge=zh, stress on -va- (zhee-oh-VAH-nee)

Guirio.who: Ouassini Guirio — fr wiki (no IPA); French: gui=ɡi, final-syllable stress (gee-ree-OH)

Keylor.who: Keylor Navas (KAY-lor; kˈAlɔɹ was heard as "Kalar", secondary stress keeps the full -lor)

Merlim.who: Alex Merlim — pt wiki (no IPA); Portuguese final -im is stressed and nasal (mehr-LEEN)

Mouhoudine.who: Souheil Mouhoudine — fr wiki (no IPA); French: ou=oo, silent h, -ine=een, final stress (moo-oo-DEEN)

Mykytiuk.who: Mykola Mykytiuk — uk wiki stress Микитю́к (mi-ki-TYUK)

Paçó.who: Tomás / Bernardo Paçó — Portuguese: ç=s, acute ó = stressed open o (pah-SAW)

Pirès.who: Robert Pirès — French [piʁɛs], final stress pee-RESS

Té.who: Zicky Té: Portuguese tɛ; a schwa off-glide lengthens the vowel so it is not clipped (TEH)

Unanua.who: Roberto Unanua — Basque/Spanish: -nua is one syllable (nwa), penultimate stress, cf. Nicaragua (oo-NAH-nwa)

Wilde.who: Wilde Gomes da Silva — pt wiki (no IPA); Brazilian Portuguese: stressed first syllable, final -de = jee (WEEL-jee)

Kuyt.who: Dirk Kuyt — nl [kœyt], English commentary KOWT

Özil.who: Mesut Özil — English commentary OH-zil (de [ˈøːzil]); Kokoro default said UR-zil

Mascherano.who: Javier Mascherano — mass-keh-RAH-no (Kokoro default said mash-er-RAH-no)

Ángel.who: Ángel Di María (AHNG-hel), not English angel

Angel.who: Ángel Di María written without accent (AHNG-hel)

Lens.who: Lens, France (Stade Bollaert) — LAHNSS; capitalised only, lower-case lens unaffected

Basten.who: Marco van Basten (Van BAS-ten, a as in bath/cat; bˈɑstən and bˈɑstɛn were heard as "Boston")

Cafuringa.who: Cafuringa, the winger Cafu was named after (player books, Sep 29 2026)

Ikorodu.who: Ikorodu, Lagos State (Oshoala) — ee-KAW-roh-doo (player books, Sep 29 2026)

Jardim.who: Jardim Irene, São Paulo (Cafu) — zhar-JEEM (player books, Sep 29 2026)

Suresnes.who: JS Suresnes (Kanté) — French syʁɛn, soo-REN (player books, Sep 29 2026)
